You don't need a max test to program with percentages.

A set of 5 at RPE 8 is about a 7-rep max, roughly 81% of 1RM. 100 kg × 5 @8 → about 123 kg estimated max.

The RPE calculator gives the working weight for any reps and RPE, rounded to your plates.

Gap coverage clause, buyer covers it, seller drops to the appraisal, or split the difference: final price, buyer cash and the seller's change for each.

Lenders and loan programs vary, so confirm the loan math with the lender.

Your client did 100 kg × 5 at RPE 8. Don't test their max.

RPE 8 means about 2 reps left, so 5 reps at RPE 8 is roughly a 7-rep max: about 123 kg estimated 1RM. No max test needed.

18 clients, 15 hours a week. Room for one more?

At 25-minute check-ins you can coach about 17. At 10 minutes, 25 fit in the same hours: at $150 a month that's $2,550 vs. $3,750. Example numbers, plug in your own.

Check-in time is the biggest lever in online coaching.

Buyer's market or seller's market? Depends on the price band.

All price bands: 4.0 months, balanced. $600k and up: 7.8 months, a buyer's market. Same town, same month.

Months of inventory = active listings ÷ sales per month. Use your MLS's numbers; thresholds vary by market.

Add weight every week? Not so fast.

Last session: 60 kg × 10 @8, 60 kg × 9 @8.5, 60 kg × 8 @9. Two of three sets are still below 10 reps. So next session: keep 60 kg and add one rep to those sets. When every set hits 10, add weight.

The calculator also gives an estimated 1RM from the best set (60 kg × 10): 80 kg. An estimate, not a max to test.
